note: Shipped reference profile (governance plane). A regulated organization protecting ordinary prompt, tool, model, workspace, and privileged activity through governance policy and evidence, with no lifecycle command required. Selectable as --profile governance-only-profile, and named by the integrated workflow profile's governance facet. Validated by validate-reference-profiles.ts against the governance profile contract; capabilities resolve against the capability registry.
scope: Baseline governance over agent activity, independent of any lifecycle workflow.
applicability: Regulated organization with mandatory policy and evidence requirements.

facetRequirements.lifecycle: No workflow plane is required; lifecycle evidence is consumed only when a workflow profile is also selected.
facetRequirements.governance: Mandatory security and privacy policies with declared applicability, accountable actors, exception handling, and fail-closed behavior.
facetRequirements.executor: Prefers deterministic and external executors for authoritative facts; agent execution requires a bounded launcher.
facetRequirements.enforcement: Required semantic intents (security, privacy, data-access) bind to enforcement points with adequate, non-experimental guarantees.
facetRequirements.data: Sensitive data is classified, minimized, redacted, retained, and access-controlled per policy.
facetRequirements.telemetry: Decision and evidence telemetry is published with correlation but no sensitive content capture.
facetRequirements.distribution: Modules declare provenance, trust, pinning, upgrade, rollback, and retirement.

failureBehavior: Mandatory controls fail closed; a policy outage on a mandatory control denies, while advisory controls observe.
absenceReport: Lifecycle results are not prerequisites; no workflow plane is claimed.
